title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
description: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.
